text:
The change moves noclab1 (10.98.0.10) from VLAN 98 (noc-lab) to VLAN 99 (noc). It should end up with the same access as noc1/noc2 (the reference), and lose its prior lab-peer relationship with noclab2, which stays on VLAN 98. The `like` test checks parity with noc1. Explicit reach tests then cover the lab and non-NOC boundaries.

```json
{"tests":[
{"t":"like","host":"noclab1","as":"noc1"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab1","dst":"noc1","svc":"*","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"noclab1","svc":"*","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab1","dst":"noc2","svc":"icmp","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noc2","dst":"noclab1","svc":"icmp","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab1","dst":"noclab2","svc":"*","expect":"deny"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab2","dst":"noclab1","svc":"*","expect":"deny"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab1","dst":"c1-host","svc":"icmp","expect":"deny"},
{"t":"reach","src":"c1-host","dst":"noclab1","svc":"icmp","expect":"deny"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab1","dst":"ext-dns1","svc":"udp/53","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"noc2","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab2","dst":"ext-dns1","svc":"udp/53","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab2","dst":"c2-host","svc":"icmp","expect":"unchanged"}
]}
```

Notes:
- The expectations for noclab1 → c1-host and → ext-dns1 mirror what noc1 is assumed to have. The `like` test is the authoritative check, and these explicit tests should be reconciled with noc1's actual policy if it differs.
- `unchanged` tests confirm that noc1, noc2 and noclab2 are unaffected by the port move.
